SERVICE ARRANGEMENTS

Confirm before booking.

Enquiries and quotations

An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Starting prices are indicative. Agree the vehicle-specific scope, full price, location and timing directly with RemapWorks UK before proceeding.

Suitability and modifications

Vehicle compatibility and condition require assessment. Customers should discuss proposed changes with their insurer and check warranty, finance and lease conditions. Fixed power gains or economy improvements are not promised.

Lawful work

Road vehicles must retain required safety and emissions systems. The website accepts enquiries for compliant diagnostic and repair services.

Business confirmation required

Legal trading identity and address, payment and deposit terms, cancellation and refund rights, complaint handling, workmanship provisions, liability wording and applicable consumer rights must be confirmed and reviewed before these terms are used with customers.
